title: Terminal Restriction Fragment Length Polymorphism (T-RFLP)
author: Eva Petrova
materials: Combine the samples and concentrate to about 50µl.

steps.title: Extract and Purify DNA
steps.instruction: Extract and purify DNA from the sample to a concentration of approximately 10-20 ng/µl.

steps.title: Amplify DNA via PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the sample using PCR with 5'-fluorescently labeled primers (at least one primer must be labeled; if both are labeled, they must have different colors).

substeps.instruction: Select primers based on target: 27F^M^I – 908R^I or 341F^I-908R^I for bacteria; 109F^I-934R^I for archea.
Perform 3 replicates of 50 µl each per sample and combine them.
Use minimum number of cycles and minimum annealing temperature (Optimized: 45°C for 24 cycles for bacteria, 25 cycles for archea).

steps.title: Perform Mung Bean Exonuclease Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the PCR product using Mung bean exonuclease according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Clean Digested PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Immediately clean the digested PCR reaction using a PCR purification kit and elute with 50 µl.

steps.title: Verify Cleanup via Agarose Gel
steps.instruction: Run 3 µl of each sample on an agarose gel to verify successful cleanup and ensure no overdigestion by the exonuclease occurred.

steps.title: Perform Restriction Enzyme Digestion
steps.instruction: Divide the remaining volume into 3 aliquots of 15 µl and digest overnight with 20U of restriction enzymes.

substeps.instruction: For bacteria (BAC), use TaqI, HhaI, and RsaI.
For archea (ARC), use TaqI, Tru1I, and MboI.

steps.title: Desalt Samples
steps.instruction: Desalt the samples using ethanol precipitation and resuspend the final product in 17 µl of PCR grade DDW.

steps.title: Run Microcapillary Sequencer
steps.instruction: Run the processed samples on an automated microcapillary sequencer.
